aboutText: Sidhu Auto Mobile Services has been serving Sunshine West and Melbourne since 2010. With over 14 years of experience, our family-owned shop provides comprehensive auto repair for all vehicles, including trucks and trailers. Our expert technicians handle everything from routine maintenance to complex engine rebuilds, ensuring your vehicle runs like new. We pride ourselves on affordable rates and trustworthy service.
servicesText: We specialise in truck and auto repair, offering everything from general maintenance to major overhauls. Our services cover all makes and models, ensuring top-quality work at reasonable rates.
